body.statement: If \(L\in\mathcal L_i(K,O)\) and \(|\operatorname{ch}_K(i)\cap L|>|\operatorname{ch}_O(i)\cap L|\), then there is a set \(S\) of \(m+1\) precision coordinates such that \[\operatorname{rank}J_K[S]\le m+1-|\operatorname{ch}_K(i)\cap L|<m+1-|\operatorname{ch}_O(i)\cap L|\le\operatorname{rank}J_O[S].\] The lower bound is certified by a nonzero incoming-star minor at a stable specialization and persists on a Zariski-open exact-support set; consequently \(\mathcal V_K^\Sigma\ne\mathcal V_O^\Sigma\).
body.justification: The Hall witness has statistical content only after it becomes an explicit graph-dependent algebraic rank gap.
body.gap: The accessible preprint proof of Theorem 4.11 uses same-graph parental closure where comparator adjacency is required and has an incoming-edge index leak; the final journal equations are unaudited.
body.consumer: The rank gap supplies the population separator required by the generic SCC recovery map.
